**Answer**

The Year 7 subject that showed the greatest improvement in the average NAPLAN score from 2012 to 2022 and also had a 2022 Australia‑wide participation rate of ≥ 91 % is **Numeracy**.

| Subject | 2012 Average Score | 2022 Average Score | Improvement (2022 – 2012) | 2022 Participation Rate |
|---------|---------------------|---------------------|---------------------------|--------------------------|
| Reading | 541.3 | 509.7 | ‑31.6 | 94.2 % |
| Writing | 517.9 | 515.9 | ‑2.0 | 87.1 % |
| Numeracy| 537.9 | 603.2 | +65.3 | 95.8 % |

* The 2012 averages come from ACARA’s 2012 NAPLAN National Report (Year 7 Reading = 541.3, Writing = 517.9, Numeracy = 537.9).  
* The 2022 averages and participation rates are taken from ACARA’s 2022 NAPLAN National Report (Reading = 509.7, 94.2 %; Writing = 515.9, 87.1 %; Numeracy = 603.2, 95.8 %).  

Because Numeracy’s improvement of +65.3 points is the largest change among the three subjects, and its 2022 participation rate (95.8 %) satisfies the ≥ 91 % threshold, Numeracy is the answer.
